preliminary.name: Design and permits
preliminary.description: Plans, building permit and a site survey. Paid with the initial payment, when you sign.

foundation.name: Foundation
foundation.description: The base of your home: footings, foundation beam and the ground-floor slab. This is where you choose the structural system.

grey_work.name: Shell
grey_work.description: Walls, columns, beams and the pipes inside them. When this stage ends, the shell of the house is done.

roof.name: Roof
roof.description: Roof structure, cover, heat insulation and ceiling.

finishes.name: Finishes
finishes.description: What you see and use: floors, doors, windows, bathrooms, kitchen, paint and lighting.

intro.metaDescription: Create your construction project: with or without land, with your plans or one of our designs. Experts guide you at every stage and you pay stage by stage.
intro.title: Create your construction project
intro.lead: A project is your home, step by step: the land, the design and the materials for each stage. You put it together here and a team of experts guides you from start to finish.

points.free: Creating your project is free and commits you to nothing
points.price: You see the cost of each stage instantly

experts.title: You are not doing it alone
experts.intro: People who know how to build in Honduras go with you. You meet them by video call before you sign.

permits.title: Permit experts
permits.body: They check your land title and get the building permit at the municipality.

architects.title: Architects
architects.body: They design your home with you or adapt your plans, or ours, to your lot.

engineers.title: Engineers
engineers.body: They design the structure, supervise the build and sign off each stage before you pay for the next.

materials.title: Materials experts
materials.body: They explain every option, buy at a good price and show you the invoices.

land.title: Your land
land.body: If you have land, tell us where it is. If not, pick one of our lots or leave it for later.

design.title: Your design
design.body: Use your own plans, design from scratch with an architect or pick a model from our catalog.

materials.title: Your materials
materials.body: Stage by stage you choose the system and materials and see how the cost changes.

panel.title: Your dashboard
panel.body: You save your project and open your dashboard: materials, payments, services, progress and support.

intro.stagesIntro: Design and permits come first. Then the build moves through 4 stages. Each stage is paid before it starts, when you see the previous one finished in photos.
intro.payBody: No interest and no financing: you pay design and permits when you sign, then each stage when you see the previous one finished.
intro.abonosBody: You can pay toward a stage's materials package before it starts. Once the package is paid, we buy the materials and deliver them to your site.
intro.abonosSoon: Online installments are coming soon. Meanwhile, we help you on WhatsApp.
intro.modelsIntro: Reference prices with the recommended materials. You can change them in your project.
intro.finalBody: Put your project together in a few minutes. Someone from our team reviews it with you before you sign anything.

wizard.metaDescription: Put together your construction project in Honduras: land, design and materials for each stage, with the cost instantly.
wizard.title: Start my project
wizard.intro: Answer a few questions. At the end you see the cost of each stage and save your project.
wizard.noscript: You need JavaScript to create your project. Message us on WhatsApp and we will put it together with you.

name.title: What is your project called?
name.hint: This is how you will see it in your dashboard. You can change it later.
name.label: Project name

land.title: Do you already have land?
land.hint: If not, you can buy one of our lots or continue without land for now.

own.label: Yes, I have land
own.hint: We build on your land, in the departments where we work.

buying_from_us.label: No, I want to buy a lot
buying_from_us.hint: Lots with reviewed paperwork. You buy it and we build your home on it.

skipped.label: Not yet, continue without land
skipped.hint: Put the project together now and choose the land later.

location.titleSkipped: Where would you like to build?
location.hintSkipped: It helps us estimate the cost: freight and labor change a little by department.
location.landAreaHint: If you don't know it, leave it blank.

lot.title: Choose your lot
lot.hint: Every lot has reviewed paperwork. We show you the title deed before you pay.
lot.empty: No lots available in that department. Pick another one or continue without land.

plans.title: Do you already have plans for your home?
plans.hint: If you do, an engineer reviews them and adapts them for the permit.

yes.label: Yes, I have plans
yes.hint: You upload them later in your dashboard. For now, just tell us the size.

no.label: I don't have plans
no.hint: We help you with the design in the next step.

design.title: How do you want your design?
design.hint: You can design from scratch with an architect or pick one of our models.

custom.label: Design from scratch
custom.hint: An architect designs your home with you, made to measure.

catalog.label: Pick a model from the catalog
catalog.hint: Ready designs with complete plans. Faster and more affordable.

details.titlePlans: What does your home look like in the plans?
details.titleCustom: How do you picture your home?
details.hint: A rough idea is enough: we use it to estimate the cost of each stage.

model.title: Choose your model
model.hint: Prices include the recommended materials. You can change them afterwards.
model.tooSmall: It may not fit on your lot

stage.floors: How many floors will your home have?
stage.floorsLocked: Your design has {count, plural, one {# floor} other {# floors}}.

summary.title: Your project
summary.hint: Review the cost of each stage. If it looks good, save it and open your dashboard.

save.title: Save your project
save.hint: We email you a private link to your dashboard. Someone from our team contacts you within one business day.
save.accountNote: You will soon be able to sign in with an account; your project will be linked to this email.

errors.rate_limited: We received several attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes or message us on WhatsApp.

summary.months: about {count, plural, one {# month} other {# months}}
summary.paymentsIntro: No interest. You pay design and permits when you sign, then each stage before it starts, when you see the previous one finished in photos.

warnings.lot_smaller_than_model_minimum: Your lot looks smaller than this model needs. We will review it with you: adjusting the design often solves it.

status.draft: Draft: we review it with you

materials.title: Choose materials
materials.body: Change the system or materials of any stage and see the new cost.

calculate.title: Calculate
calculate.body: With what you set aside each month, see when you start and when you finish.

contribute.title: Pay toward materials
contribute.body: Pay toward a stage's materials package before it starts. Online soon; today we help you on WhatsApp.

services.title: Hire services
services.body: Land survey, soil study, design, supervision or paperwork.

progress.title: Request a progress proof
progress.body: Photos, video or a site visit for your family.

support.title: Support
support.body: Questions? Write to us and a person will answer.

panel.materialsIntro: Tap an option to change it. The cost is recalculated and saved automatically.
panel.materialsLocked: Your project is already under review: to change materials, write to us.

abonos.title: Materials packages
abonos.intro: Each stage has its materials package. You can pay toward it before the stage starts; once it is paid, we buy the materials and deliver them to your site.
